name: io.github.midhunxavier/opcua
title: OPC UA MCP Server
description: MCP server for OPC UA: read, write, browse, call methods, history, events and alarms.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: OPC UA endpoint, including its path. The bundled plant mock listens on opc.tcp://localhost:4840/freeopcua/server/.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: None, Basic128Rsa15, Basic256, Basic256Sha256, and on the Node runtime also Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep and Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss. Anything other than None needs the client certificate and key below.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: None, Sign or SignAndEncrypt. Defaults to SignAndEncrypt once a security policy is set.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the client certificate (PEM or DER) the session presents.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the private key matching OPCUA_CLIENT_CERT. A path, not key material.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_APPLICATION_URI
environmentVariables.description: Application URI announced to the server. Defaults to the subjectAltName URI of the client certificate; set it only for a certificate that carries none.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: OPC UA username. The session is anonymous when unset.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for OPCUA_USERNAME. Without a security policy it crosses the network in clear text.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_INITIAL_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: First wait before retrying a dropped or refused connection, in ms. Each further attempt doubles it.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for the doubling backoff, in ms.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_MAX_RETRY
environmentVariables.description: Retries after the first attempt. 0 disables retrying; -1 retries forever.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Session timeout asked of the OPC UA server, in ms. It also sets the keep-alive period.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile. observe (default) advertises read, browse, history and monitoring tools only; operator adds explicitly allowlisted writes and methods; full exposes every tool.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_POLICY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a version-1 JSON policy file. The environment variables below override what it sets.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool allowlist. It can only narrow the selected profile, never widen it.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_WRITE_NODES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact node IDs the operator profile may write. A batch write is rejected outright if any target falls outside it.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_METHODS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated object_node_id|method_node_id pairs the operator profile may call.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_ACKNOWLEDGE_ALARMS
environmentVariables.description: Allow the operator profile to acknowledge alarms. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL
environmentVariables.description: Lab-only override permitting control tools on an unsecured OPC UA channel. Defaults to false.
